title: Positivity properties of Schur classes
summary: Results of Fulton-Lazarsfeld and Ross-Toma show that Schur classes of ample and nef vector bundles have remarkable positivity properties. We generalize these results to a purely algebraic setting. We show that if a projective bundle ring, a ring which resembles the cohomology ring of a projective bundle over a smooth complex projective variety, has the Kähler package with respect to a suitable cone, then the associated Schur classes satisfy a version of the Hodge-Riemann relations.
